subject: Pricing & commitment follow-up \u0014 NovaFlow discovery
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (pricing)

Hi Samir (and Ava),

Thanks again for taking the time today  great conversation and really excited about NovaFlow's roadmap for inference-driven document understanding. Quick recap from my side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Production profile: primary workload is extractive QA + reranking for documents (avg input length ~800 tokens, expected output ~150 tokens).
- Expected volume: pilot = ~28M tokens/month (in month 13), scale to ~220M tokens/month by month 9 if POC goes well.
- Latency SLO: P95 < 350ms for single-turn queries; happy to scope dedicated pool for this.
- Key ask: target unit economics around $7009 00 / 1M tokens for generation-heavy traffic (combined read/write).

Next steps I propose:
1) Ill send a short pricing sketch for startup program + committed-use options (1yr / 2yr) for the volumes you shared.
2) Ben (cc) will run a quick cost model to show net effective $/1M tokens under different commit levels and quantization profiles.
3) If numbers make sense, we can get a draft MSA + SOW ready and lean on the startup program for the initial term.

Attachments: Ill include the pricing sheet and a committed-use term sheet in the follow-up.

Anything I missed? Otherwise Ill follow up tomorrow with the sketch.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@novaflow.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 17:02:12 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (pricing)

Thanks Marissa  this looks right. A couple of clarifications from Ava and me: 

- The volume cadence is roughly: months 13 pilot 2530M tokens/mo, months 46 80120M tokens/mo, months 712 150220M tokens/mo. Peak month could be ~240M.
- Budget: we have an internal target to keep unit spend under ~$850 / 1M tokens on average over year 1. If committed-use discounts can push us to ~$6007 00 / 1M at scale, that's very compelling.
- Contract preference: 1224 month committed use with quarterly true-ups. Startup program credits would help shorten the ramp risk.

Look forward to the sketch. Also please include any assumptions on token counting (input vs output split), quantization profiles (FP16 vs 4-bit), and support tiers.

Samir
Co-founder & Head of ML
NovaFlow

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@novaflow.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:20:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Quick recap + next steps (pricing)

Thanks for the detail Samir  ran a quick back-of-envelope with Marissa's profile. Key assumptions I used (will attach a cleaner workbook in final):

- Token split: 70% input / 30% output average (matches your extraction/QA profile at ~800/150 tokens).
- Baseline unit list price (hosted, no commit) for the model class we discussed: $1,200 / 1M tokens.
- 1yr committed-use discounts optical: 
  - 100M/mo commit -> ~35% off list = ~$780 / 1M tokens
  - 200M/mo commit -> ~45% off list = ~$660 / 1M tokens
  - 300M/mo commit -> ~52% off list = ~$576 / 1M tokens
- Startup program: additional one-time credit equal to 3 months of baseline usage on first-year committed term (applied as invoice credit).
- Multi-year (2yr) incentive: additional 8% off committed discount band plus price protection caps.

If we lean toward a 1224mo commit, you should be able to get into the ~$6007 50 / 1M tokens range at the 150220M scale, which lines up with your target. Ill formalize with the workbook and a per-month cashflow table.

Ben
Pricing Ops (Redwood)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novaflow.ai>, Ava Liu <ava@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:45:00 +0000
Subject: Pricing sketch + committed-use options (NovaFlow)

Hi Samir / Ava 

Attached: NovaFlow-pricing-sheet-APR2027.pdf, CommittedUse-term-sheet.xlsx (link to HubSpot deal below). Summary highlights below  please treat this as a sketch to help you decide next steps; final numbers will be in the contract draft.

1) Baseline assumptions (so we're comparing apples):
   - Model family: gen-llama-2-13b-like performance tier (production-optimized).
   - Token split: 70% input / 30% output.
   - Typical per-token processing optimization applied (prefix caching for repeated prompts on Q&A).

2) Pricing paths (net $ / 1M tokens after commit & startup credits):
   - No commit (hosted list): $1,200 / 1M tokens
   - 12mo commit bands:
       * 100M/mo commit -> $780 / 1M tokens (approx 35% off)
       * 200M/mo commit -> $660 / 1M tokens (approx 45% off)
       * 300M/mo commit -> $576 / 1M tokens (approx 52% off)
   - 24mo commit (multi-year incentive): additional 8% off the 12mo net price + price protection cap (max increase 3%/yr)

3) Startup program (for qualified early-stage companies):
   - One-time credit equal to 3 months of baseline usage applied during year 1 when a 12mo commit is signed.
   - Eligibility: < $5M ARR, VC-backed, and use-case alignment (we have your paperwork from the call).

4) Example effective cost (your stated ramp):
   - Pilot months (2530M): effective $/1M = list price reduced by startup credit amortization -> ~ $9501,050 / 1M
   - Mid ramp (80120M): with a 1002200M commit cadence -> ~$700760 / 1M (depending on exact band)
   - Target scale (150220M): with 200M+ commit or 24mo -> ~$600680 / 1M

5) Contract mechanics & next steps:
   - We support quarterly true-ups and look-back reconciliation. Excess usage billed at tiered overage rates (lower than list).
   - If you want early termination protection or ramp guarantees, we can include a structured ramp clause (reduced shortfall fees in year 1).
   - Next: if you confirm which commit band you prefer, Ill loop in legal to prepare a draft MSA + SOW and Ben will finalize the committed-use workbook.

Attachments: NovaFlow-pricing-sheet-APR2027.pdf (pricing bands & worked examples), CommittedUse-term-sheet.xlsx (commit mechanics, ramp clause examples)

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DF-7890 (deal record)

Happy to hop on a quick 2030m call today if you want to walk numbers.

Best,
Marissa

From: Samir Patel <samir@novaflow.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Liu <ava@novaflow.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pricing sketch + committed-use options (NovaFlow)

This is great, thanks. A few quick items: 

- Can you confirm the startup credit mechanics in writing (how it appears on invoice / amortization schedule)?
- We'd like a draft MSA + SOW to review. Aim: sign within 23 weeks if terms look good.
- Based on the numbers, we're inclined to target the 200M/mo commitment band (12mo) with a possible 24mo extension if legal signs off on price protection  want to see the commitment workbook before finalizing.

If you can send the contract draft + workbook today or tomorrow, Ill circulate internally and get back with any redlines. Also please include an estimated implementation timeline for dedicated pool provisioning.

Thanks  Samir
